Presidential Library notes that the eastern section was only generally outlined, source-language versions differed, landmarks were ambiguous, accurate maps were unavailable and physical demarcation was not performed. Reconstruct identifiable river/watershed segments and represent unresolved portions as a broad uncertainty corridor.

The documentary record states that a geodetic survey was undertaken and the entire new boundary was mapped. Locate the actual 1727 survey/cartographic sheets and georeference them before promoting this change to geometry-verified.

The treaty text specifies the line through the Amur, Ussuri, Sungacha, Lake Khanka, Belenkhe/Tur and the mountain watershed toward the Tumen, and a map of the eastern boundary was attached. Acquire the treaty map scan and georeference the boundary before geometry verification.

Use the exchanged boundary maps and protocol as the preferred geometry authority for the Ussuri sector. This change should supersede less precise treaty-text reconstruction when the map sheets are georeferenced.
